# typescript-language-adapter

## Rules

### Scope & Languages
- Handles `.ts` (`typescript`), `.tsx` (`tsx`), `.js` (`javascript`), `.jsx` (`jsx`).
- Single-pass parsing via Tree-sitter/ast-grep; outputs `FileAnalysisDraft` without AST retention.

### Declarations & Owners
- Extracts functions, callable variables/arrows/HOFs, classes, methods, fields, prototype/static assignments, namespace/member assignments, destructured bindings, exports, type aliases, interfaces, enums.
- Construct range = complete node; `selectionRange` = declared identifier. Retains attached JSDoc/block comments.
- Declaring owner derived from construct containment. Same-name members across owners remain distinct. Top-level declarations have no owner.

### Imports & Exports
- Extracts named/default/namespace/type-only/side-effect/aliased static imports, ESM/CJS exports, literal `import()` and `require()`. Drops non-literal dynamic imports/requires.
- Public export slots track surface, exported name, symbol space, target, re-export route (no overwriting competing routes). Relative imports evaluate extension/index candidates.

### Scoped Bindings, Calls & Relations
- Emits deterministic facts for lexical scopes, params, constructor properties, fields, return types, `this` bindings, `new` construction.
- Emits `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` only when proven by local/imported/receiver facts.
- Innermost function/method = caller. Drops module-scope calls, ambiguous receivers, unresolved globals, computed members.

### Hierarchy & Evidence
- Extracts `extends`/`implements` -> emits `EXTENDS` (class/interface), `IMPLEMENTS` (class->interface), `OVERRIDES` (member replacement).
- Reference facts retain child owner, ancestor/contract owner, relation kind, precedence, provenance steps for `ResolveSymbolReference`. Bounded cycle termination.
- Advertises `hierarchy: true`. Unsupported syntax (mixins, decorators, declaration merging) dropped, not guessed.

### Package & Capability Boundary
- Bounded search upward to repo root for `package.json` `name`.
- `tsconfig` paths/baseUrl, conditional `exports`/`imports` unsupported -> advertises `buildContext: false`.
- Parse failure/unsupported syntax reported via shared coverage; NO name-only guessing.

## Constraints
- NO code execution or TypeScript compiler invocations.
- Runtime reflection, computed exports, monkey patching -> unsupported.
- TS-specific syntax logic MUST stay inside adapter.
